rationale: C16 is the strongest candidate because it is an earlier executive order with the same distinctive title formula and identical administrative function: exempting a specifically named individual from compulsory retirement for age. C03 and C21 are also strong instances of the same reusable order form, but C16 is the most recent before the child and thus the most plausible immediate drafting template. The absence of published operative text limits direct comparison but does not undermine the highly specific title-and-function match.
